beats.say: Someone fixed production by hand. Now nobody knows what runs there.
The cluster and your files have drifted apart.
beats.label: Drift
beats.head: The cluster and Git disagree

beats.say: This port has three steps: the idea, Argo CD, and promotion.
beats.label: Port 10 · GitOps

check.prompt: Someone changes a Deployment by hand. Self-heal is on. What does the agent do?
check.why: Git is the desired state. The agent makes the cluster match Git again.

beats.say: First: make Git the only door.
Git holds the desired state. An agent in the cluster pulls it and applies it.
beats.label: GitOps
beats.head: The cluster pulls from Git

beats.say: It is the control loop again, one level up.
beats.label: Familiar
beats.head: The same loop, one level up

beats.say: A rollback is a revert in Git. And your pipeline needs no cluster password.
beats.label: What you gain
beats.head: Rollback = git revert

beats.say: You give Argo CD one object: which repository, which path, which namespace.
beats.label: Application
beats.head: Repository, path, namespace

beats.say: Synced means the cluster matches Git. Healthy means the app works. You need both.
beats.label: Two states
beats.head: Synced and Healthy

beats.say: Third: move a release to production.
Keep one folder per environment. Promote with a pull request.
beats.label: Promotion
beats.head: A folder per environment

beats.say: Never put a secret in Git. A tool copies it from a secret manager.
beats.label: Secrets
beats.head: Secrets stay out of Git

beats.say: Git is the truth. The cluster pulls. And a rollback is a revert.
beats.label: GitOps

beats.say: Now start the first lesson below.
